subject.title: Downey Unified School District Board, Trustee Area 7

text: Occupation: Special Education Mom/Businesswoman

My name is Betty Luz Monroy, and I bring extensive experience serving on public boards, commissions, and school-related leadership roles. I served 16 years as Chair of the Downey Library Board, four years on the Downey Parks & Recreation Commission, and 10 years as Sports Parent Liaison for Warren High School Athletics. I also supported Special Education programs as the Classroom Parent Liaison at Rio Hondo Elementary, strengthening collaboration between staff, families, and students.
My Priorities
Special Education:
As the mother of three special-needs graduates of Downey Unified, I understand IEPs, advocacy, and the importance of inclusive learning environments.
Balanced Three-Year Budget:
I support fiscal responsibility and transparency to maintain stability and avoid state intervention.
School Safety:
I will work to improve pick-up and drop-off systems to protect students and families.
Student Success Beyond Graduation:
I want to expand pathways that prepare students for college, careers, trades, and independent adulthood.
Contact: bettymonroy4schoolboard@gmail.com # 562-746-1839
Now Semi-retired, I am ready to dedicate my time and experience to serving our community. I believe in teamwork, transparency, and listening to all voices. Children's education is my priority.

text: Age: 43
Occupation: Appointed Incumbent

I'm Joseph Manacmul. Downey isn't just where I live. Ward Elementary, South Middle (Sussman), and Downey High are where I learned to read, made my first friends, and fell in love with this community. Today, my three children attend Downey Unified schools, and my wife teaches in our district. This place raised me. Now I have the honor of giving back to the schools and community that shaped me.

I was appointed to the Board during a difficult district transition. Since then, I've studied budgets closely, walked Measure K construction sites, and pressed for clearer answers on spending because parents deserve facts, not guesswork.

I earned a bachelor's degree from UCLA and a master's from Pepperdine. Managing small businesses and a local nonprofit gave me hands-on experience balancing budgets under real risk—and uniting parents, educators, and community partners.

As parents and neighbors, you deserve my continued focus on safe schools, strong reading and math fundamentals, expanded career pathways, less digital distraction, and responsible use of taxpayer dollars.
I respectfully ask for your vote so we can stay rooted in this community, help every student grow, and keep Downey strong.
